CustomField.formula:
IF(
DATE( YEAR( TODAY() ) , MONTH( Customer_Birth_Date__c ) , DAY( Customer_Birth_Date__c ) ) <= TODAY() ,
DATE( YEAR( TODAY() + 1 ) , MONTH( Customer_Birth_Date__c ) , DAY( Customer_Birth_Date__c ) ) ,
DATE( YEAR( TODAY() ) , MONTH(Customer_Birth_Date__c ), DAY(Customer_Birth_Date__c ) )
)
CustomField.label: Customers Next Birthdate
